I run **Barrett Evaluation, LLC**, working with individuals, non-profits, and companies on data management, analytics, and statistical modeling. Projects have spanned education, communication sciences, economics, psychology, and biology.

## What a project looks like

| Project type | What you receive |
|---|---|
| **Research** — scientific or business improvement | Technical reports, published papers, data management and cleaning, documented R code, a replicable workflow |
| **Production** — part of a larger system | Production-level code, technical documentation, data cleaning pipelines |

Most engagements start in one of three places: a dataset that needs to be made trustworthy before anything else can happen, an analysis that needs a methodologist's review before submission, or a one-off model that needs to become something a team can run every month.

## Get in touch

Contact me for a **free intake conversation** — email [t.barrett88@gmail.com](mailto:t.barrett88@gmail.com). I try to respond within 48 hours.

Useful things to include: what question you are trying to answer, what data already exists, and when you need it by.
